name: Hiei Mami
source:
Hobbies: Kendo, [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iaido]Iaido[/url]
Likes: Scooter maintenance and washing, [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gao_Xingjian]Gao ****jian[/url]
Dislikes: Dogs (as a result of a childhood trauma).
Favorite phrase: "Because of my own unskillfulness"

A mysterious girl who always has a sword at her waist. Mami seems to have a hostility (?) towards [url=/c12036]Akira[/url]. However, she almost never talks to Akira, so the later doesn't know her true intentions. Mami's motive for this behavior is that she thinks her duty is protecting the school from things she doesn't know anything about by fighting them. Surprisingly enough, she loves sweets; her favorite is a super sweet chocolate red bean bread series.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=769298]Getchu[/url].]
